claim_boundary: This plan proves structural course-wide assessment coverage only. It does not establish assessment validity, learner mastery, a grade, credit, Ministry approval, educator review, or psychometric calibration.

stages.correction_path: a reviewed correction and reassessment route is mandatory before this stage may contribute to a governed course result

promotion_requirements: qualified educator review of assessment validity and expectation alignment
reviewed scoring guides and constructed-response exemplars
correction, reassessment, and appeal workflow verification
evidence bound to the exact assessment-content revision
